title: Core Awakening
css: body{margin:0;background:#0A4D68;overflow:hidden}canvas{display:block}#hud{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}#hud .panel{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7);border:2px solid #FFC93C;padding:10px;margin:10px;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);border-radius:5px}#hud .label{color:#FFC93C;font-size:20px;font-weight:bold}#hud .value{color:#FFFFFF;font-size:20px}#hud .objective{font-size:18px;color:#FFC93C;position:absolute;top:50px;left:20px;pointer-events:none}#background{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;z-index:-1}#background .layer{position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;z-index:-1}#layer1{background:rgba(62,124,157,0.3);transform:translateY(-10px);animation:move1 30s linear infinite;}#layer2{background:rgba(10,77,104,0.5);transform:translateY(10px);animation:move2 40s linear infinite;}@keyframes move1{0%{background-position:0 0;}100%{background-position:100% 0;}}@keyframes move2{0%{background-position:0 0;}100%{background-position:0 100%;}}
